rules: Entity rows are exactly the 60 not_measured entities of the dry-run CAR ff07be2..3452dd9 (51 routes, 7 API controllers, 2 web API clients); every one of the 51 swept routes is in probes.

Each route receives an authenticated loopback HTTP request expecting its success status and an unauthenticated control expecting 401|403. Code-unit rows aggregate their bound routes as bound in PR321's plan (receipts/canary/bcab5202/pr321-1ae2f0e/plan.json).

GET /tasks/project/:projectId/index is called with a key of the real aup-orchestrator agent id on the real aup project id; under DEC-AUP-0033 A3 that grant is standing, so the probe expects 200; the returned grant object is recorded in index_grant_returned (no renewalDueAt).
GET /tasks/digest is called with a key of the real arcanada-assistant agent id; that grant is standing since PR 321, so the probe expects 200.
